git_checkout.reuse_rule: Reuse an existing authorized local repository when available; otherwise obtain a fresh Git repository. Always fetch current main before resolving rules_source_sha.
git_checkout.cleanliness_rule: Planner Python must execute from a clean detached snapshot whose HEAD exactly equals rules_source_sha. Unrelated uncommitted changes in another worktree must not contaminate the planner snapshot.
git_checkout.authentication_rule: Use environment-provided Git authorization when available. Authentication failure selects connector_materialization fallback rather than stale local source.
git_checkout.failure_rule: If current main cannot be fetched or the exact resolved commit cannot be checked out and verified, use connector_materialization fallback. Never plan from stale Git state.

repository_identity.source: Exact current-main commit SHA resolved by preferred Git fetch/rev-parse or by GitHub API/connector fallback

connector_materialization.source_bytes: The complete decoded UTF-8 content returned by GitHub fetch_file/API responses for the exact requested path and rules_source_sha is the canonical file content.
connector_materialization.preferred_fetch: Fetch the complete file in one response when possible.

chunked_fetch_fallback.trigger: Use when a connector/UI response is truncated, clipped or elided because the file is large.
chunked_fetch_fallback.method: Refetch the same path and exact rules_source_sha with explicit non-overlapping start_line/end_line ranges until every source line has been obtained, then concatenate ranges in ascending order preserving original newline boundaries.
prohibited: retyping or reconstructing from a truncated visible excerpt
treating one truncated presentation response as source unavailability

blob_verification.expected_sha_source: GitHub connector fetch_file blob sha for the exact path/ref
blob_verification.failure_rule: Fail closed if reconstructed bytes do not match the connector-returned Git blob SHA.

connector_materialization.write_rule: ChatGPT/Work creates parent directories and writes verified connector-returned content directly to ordinary local files at repository-relative paths under a temporary materialization root.
connector_materialization.failure_rule: Fail closed when required source ranges cannot be fetched, reconstructed bytes fail blob verification, bytes cannot be written, or a required canonical Python entrypoint fails after writing.

source_rule: Preferred Git mode reads all repository-owned planner state directly from one clean detached checkout at rules_source_sha. Connector fallback materializes shared_required_python_files and shared_required_data_files plus only the selected profile additions from the exact rules_source_sha. No production promotion or publishing module is required merely to execute planner-time Python.

immutable_cache.shared_cache_scope: Reusable Git object database/clone in Git mode; shared_required_python_files + shared_required_data_files in connector fallback
immutable_cache.validation_rule: Git reuse must fetch current main and create/verify a clean detached exact-SHA snapshot. Connector reuse is valid only when previously verified Git blob SHAs belong to the identical rules_source_sha manifest entry.
immutable_cache.sha_change_rule: A newer current-main SHA must be classified by planner-relevant drift before reusing prior planning work. Never silently execute planner Python from stale source bytes.

planner_state_placeholders.rule: For explicit existence/uniqueness checks in connector fallback, materialize zero-byte placeholder files for matching canonical repository paths. Their contents are not read by those checks. Git mode reads the real exact-SHA repository state directly.

categories.rules: refresh source snapshot; rerun planner contract, media readiness and complete precommit
categories.media: refresh media state; rerun media readiness, background selection validation and complete precommit
categories.history: refresh creative/history inputs; rerun duplicate, analytics and recent-background reasoning; rerun complete precommit whenever authored pool bytes change
categories.operational: do not restart planning solely for operational evidence/recovery/completion changes

drift_policy.connector_fallback_rule: If main changes and connector/API tooling cannot provide the changed path set safely, conservatively perform a full refresh. If changed paths are available, apply the same category policy.

performance_diagnostics.rule: Measure with a monotonic clock around actual work. Diagnostics are observability only and must not influence creative ranking or validation.

baseline.optimization: Git-first exact repository snapshots avoid repeated per-file connector reconstruction when Git access is available; connector materialization remains the correctness-preserving fallback.

forbidden_bootstrap_requirements: running planner Python from an unpinned mutable checkout
silently mixing source/state files from different commits
using stale cached source after current-main fetch failure
